# 厉鬼 (ligui)

Ligui is a thin, model-agnostic agent built on
DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`).

This repository is a **dsh bundle**, not a fork. It composes the published
harness and contributes o

ne patch layer: the agent's identity, the model routes
it exposes, and its Web theme. Upstream stays

upstream, so a `dsh` upgrade is a
dependency update rather than a merge.
## What's in the box
| File | Purpose |

| `cordis.patch.yml` | The composition layer: persona, provider routes, theme row |
| `client.js` |

Browser half: the Ligui theme's `--dsw-*` token layer |
| `index.js` | Host half: the Loader row, pl

us the native `computer` tool |
| `native/` | C input helper: Interception driver, SendInput fallbac

k |
| `skills/` | Global skill templates for memory and self-improvement |
| `scripts/install-skills

.sh` | Installs those templates into `~/.dsh/skills` |
| `package.json` | The `dsh.bundle` + `dsh.cl

ient` manifest |
| `examples/custom-routes.example.yml` | Shapes for OpenAI Chat/Responses and Anthr
opic Messages gateways |
## Requirements

- Node.js **24.9+**
- `pnpm` on `PATH` (only when installing the bundle into a profile)
- `dsh` 0.2.

## Model support

Ligui deliberately does not pin a model. `dsh-base` mounts the native DeepSeek
adapter and the multi

-provider `dsh-llm-pi-ai` adapter; this bundle activates
the built-in provider routes below.
| Wire protocol | Provider id | Credential env |

| DeepSeek native API | `deepseek-official` | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` |
| OpenAI Chat Completions + Respo

nses | `openai` | `OPENAI_API_KEY` |
| Anthropic Messages | `anthropic` | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` |
| Go

ogle Gemini | `google` | `GEMINI_API_KEY` |
| OpenRouter (many upstreams) | `openrouter` | `OPENROUT

ER_API_KEY` |
| Moonshot / Kimi | `moonshotai` | `MOONSHOT_API_KEY` |
| Z.ai / GLM | `zai` | `ZAI_AP

EY` |
| Moonshot / Kimi | `moonshotai` | `MOONSHOT_API_KEY` |
| Z.ai / GLM | `zai` | `ZAI_API_KEY` |

Export a key before launch, or enter it in **Settings → Models**. A saved
credential outranks the en

vironment reference. A route with no key still
appears in the picker; its requests fail with `MISSIN

G_CREDENTIAL` until a
credential exists.

Selecting a model in the picker makes it the default for new sessions. Before
any selection, the def

ault is `deepseek-official` / `deepseek-flash`, inherited
from `dsh-base`.
### Add a custom gateway

Any endpoint that speaks one of the three protocols works without code. Add a
route under `providers

` in `cordis.patch.yml` (or your profile patch) with
`api`, `baseURL`, and an explicit `models` list

. See
`examples/custom-routes.example.yml`.

A gateway that serves two protocols needs two routes: one provider speaks one
`api`.
### Add a bespoke protocol

If the model's wire format is not OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, or Anthropic
Messages, implement an

`LlmAdapter` and register it on `ctx.llm`; no fork is
needed. Start from the upstream guide:
LLM ad

apter` and register it on `ctx.llm`; no fork is
needed. Start from the upstream guide:
LLM adapters.
## Theme

The Web UI boots with a Ligui skin: near-black surfaces with a red undertone, a hot-rod red
primary,
warm white text, and sparing orange/yellow highlights, tighter corners (3–18px instead of the stock

4–28px), and faster
motion (0.09s / 0.14s / 0.22s instead of 0.1s / 0.2s / 0.3s).

`client.js` registers one `ctx.theme.overrideTokens` layer over the active
palette. It never changes

the user's preference, so **Settings → General →
Appearance** keeps working in light, dark, and sys

tem mode. There is no build
step: `dsh.client` serves the browser half as-is.

To tune the skin, edit `TOKENS` in `client.js` and reload the page. Every value
must be a `{ light,

dark }` pair; `overrideTokens` rejects a bare string so a
scheme switch can never make the UI illegi

}` pair; `overrideTokens` rejects a bare string so a
scheme switch can never make the UI illegible.

The theme does not replace the product wordmark: the sidebar still reads
"DeepSeek Harness". Changin

g that needs a slot registration (a React client
plugin), which this repo does not ship yet.

## Desktop

The `desktop/` folder is a thin Electron shell. It starts the bundled dsh
runtime on a free loopback

port, reads the token URL from its output, and loads
Ligui in a native window — no browser tab and

oken URL from its output, and loads
Ligui in a native window — no browser tab and no browser chrome.

It shares `~/.dsh` with the CLI, so sessions, workspaces, and settings are the
same in both.
**Prerequisites:** Node.js 24+, npm.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The build produces:

- `desktop/dist/win-unpacked/Ligui.exe` — instant launch, keep the folder together
- `desktop/dist/L

igui-0.1.0-portable.exe` — one file, but it self-extracts the
bundled runtime on first launch, which

table.exe` — one file, but it self-extracts the
bundled runtime on first launch, which takes minutes

Electron is pinned to **44.7.0**. dsh's native module loader accepts only
43.0.0, 44.0.0, 44.7.0, an

d 45.0.0-alpha.6; any other Electron build fails at
boot with `unsupported Electron runtime fingerpr

0.0-alpha.6; any other Electron build fails at
boot with `unsupported Electron runtime fingerprint`.
The shell is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch.
